name: midas-sdlc
description: Gated Midas SDLC. Blocks outward actions until the developer answers in chat: Azure DevOps writes, Azure DevOps pages in the browser, and session, schedule and app-setting tools. Answers are typed messages such as 'Accept G8 362525' or 'Approve: comment 362525', and each one is recorded in a gate ledger. Full guide: the homepage link.
